overview.name: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long DRAM ETF
overview.description: The fund has adopted a policy to have at least 80% exposure to financial instruments with economic characteristics that should perform 2X the daily performance of the Underlying Security’s shares. It is expected to allocate between 40% and 60% of its assets as collateral for swap agreements or as premiums for purchased options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
